[36;1m    # count read off the driver's last round.[0m

[36;1m      && not_fixed "The agent changed no source, so the defect \`${PC_TARGET}\` is still reported."[0m
[36;1m    echo "::notice::the fix did not change any source; nothing to propose"[0m
[36;1m    echo "No change was kept. \`fix-issue\` restores its snapshot when its accept gates do not hold, so this finding needs a different remedy." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"[0m
[36;1m  # WHO WROTE THIS CHANGE IS THE FIRST THING A REVIEWER NEEDS, and the two[0m

[36;1m  # on, so the provenance is chosen here rather than written once for both.[0m
[36;1m    MADE_BY="\`predictable fix\`, an agent working in a checkout of this repository until the analysis verified its change"[0m

[36;1m    HOW="**An agent wrote this.** It was given the finding and asked to fix the underlying defect, not to silence it. This run re-analysed the change before proposing it, and the analysis no longer reports the finding — still, read it as you would any pull request from a colleague."[0m

[36;1m    HOW="**This is not an agent's work.** \`predictable analyze fix-issue\` edits narrowly and keeps the edit only if its own accept gates hold, so what is here was re-checked before it was proposed. It is still a change to your source, and it is here to be reviewed."[0m
[36;1m  # WHAT THIS ATTEMPT CHANGED, read from the index before it is committed, for the fix[0m
[36;1m  # branch's `.analysis.json` (#2240): the Control Center holds no tree, so this is the[0m
[36;1m  # one measurement of the change set it can rest an `applied` verdict on.[0m
[36;1m  # AN AGENT FIX IS VERIFIED BEFORE ANYTHING LEAVES THIS RUNNER.[0m
[36;1m  # The commit above is re-analysed exactly as committed, and the pull request is opened[0m
[36;1m  # ONLY when that analysis no longer reports the finding. Otherwise nothing is pushed,[0m
[36;1m  # no pull request exists, and the run FAILS saying the fix did not work. Proposing[0m
[36;1m  # first and checking after was how a fix whose finding was still reported got merged:[0m
[36;1m  # a pull request can be merged by auto-merge before any check of ours has run.[0m
[36;1m  # The agent already looped fix → sync → check inside its session; this is the gate that[0m
[36;1m  # does not take its word for it.[0m
[36;1m  # A SYNC IS NEVER HANDED A MODEL KEY (#2103): the agent's key is in this job, so the[0m
[36;1m  # re-analysis runs with the model key and the job's token unset — it asks no model, and[0m
[36;1m  # it must not be able to. It PUBLISHES NOTHING (`PREDICTABLE_REPORTED_RUN`): the fix[0m
[36;1m  # branch is not pushed yet, and an analysis of a fix that did not work is not one[0m
[36;1m  # anybody reads. A verified one is published below, once its branch is on origin.[0m
[36;1m    [ -n "${PC_FINDING:-}" ] || not_fixed "This run was not told which finding to check (\`finding\` is empty), so the fix cannot be verified."[0m
[36;1m    # THE FIX BRANCH STARTS FROM THE ANALYSIS THAT FOUND THE FINDING, reused only when it[0m
[36;1m    # was written by THIS build, exactly as the open step decides for a sync, because[0m
[36;1m    # reporting an old build's dataset as current costs trust.[0m
[36;1m    # AS COMMITTED, not as the agent left it on disk: its own syncs ran over the base[0m
[36;1m    # branch's entry (publishing nothing, but writing the files), and it could edit them.[0m
[36;1m    # The committed entry is put back and anything untracked in it removed; what stays is[0m

[36;1m    echo "Re-analysing ${BRANCH} to tell whether ${PC_TARGET} is fixed."[0m
[36;1m    # THE SAME CHECK the agent, its Stop hook and the driver ran (#2306): `fix-check`,[0m
[36;1m    # against the starting point the driver recorded. `gone` needs the finding absent[0m

[36;1m      echo "::group::Re-analysis of the fix ($(wc -l < "$VERIFY_LOG" | tr -d ' ') lines)"[0m
[36;1m      not_fixed "Re-analysing the fix did not finish (exit ${VERIFY_STATUS}), so there is no evidence that \`${PC_TARGET}\` is gone. The re-analysis output above says why."[0m
[36;1m      || not_fixed "The analysis of the fixed code does not show \`${PC_TARGET}\` fixed (${VERIFY_VERDICT}): ${VERIFY_REASON}"[0m
[36;1m    echo "The analysis of the fixed code no longer reports ${PC_TARGET}: ${VERIFY_REASON}"[0m

[36;1m    echo "Added this attempt to the open pull request for \`${PC_TARGET}\`." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"[0m

[36;1m  # THE VERIFIED ANALYSIS IS PUBLISHED UNDER THE FIX BRANCH'S NAME (#2240), now that the[0m

[36;1m  # any branch's analysis. Nothing is analysed again: `publish` records what the[0m

[36;1m  # is not published only means the Control Center says it could not read it.[0m
[36;1m  # WHAT THE RECORD SAYS DIFFERENTLY FOR A FIX, and nothing else: the entry and the[0m
[36;1m  # `branch` are the fix branch's, and the record says which attempt it answers and what[0m
[36;1m    '{attempt: (if $attempt == "" then null else $attempt end), finding: $finding, base: $base,[0m

[36;1m  # publish refuses to commit — this job's agent had the key, and could have written it[0m
[36;1m    unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN PC_MODEL_KEY GH_TOKEN PREDICTABLE_REPORTED_RUN[0m
[36;1m    || echo "::warning::the verified analysis of ${BRANCH} was not published; the check below says what origin holds"[0m
[36;1m# AN ANALYSIS IS A COMMIT ON `predictable-code-database`, never a pull request, and the[0m
[36;1m# SYNC MADE IT: `predictable sync` commits the branch's analysis to the database it checked[0m
[36;1m# out at `.predictable-code/` and pushes it, exactly as on a developer's machine. What is[0m
[36;1m# checked here is the outcome — origin's database records THIS commit as this branch's[0m
[36;1m# analysis — and the run says so, or says why not.[0m
[36;1m# WHOSE ANALYSIS THIS IS: the branch the run was dispatched on, or — for an agent fix,[0m
[36;1m# which set it above — the fix branch it committed to (#2240).[0m
[36;1m  # WHY, IN THE SYNC'S OWN WORDS. Its publish outcome ("Not published: …", "already[0m

[36;1m    -exec grep -hE 'Published the analysis|already carries this analysis|Not published:' {} + \[0m
[36;1m  # A RULE ON THE REPOSITORY is the one refusal a re-run will not fix, so it is named:[0m
[36;1m  # a ruleset that covers every branch also covers this one.[0m
[36;1m    echo "### The analysis could not be published"[0m

[36;1m    echo "Origin's \`${DATA_BRANCH}\` does not hold this analysis of \`${PC_ANALYSED_BRANCH}\`. If a ruleset or branch protection covers every branch of this repository, exempt \`${DATA_BRANCH}\`: it carries only Predictable's data and is never merged."[0m
[36;1m      echo "The sync recorded no publish outcome in its log, so it never reached the publish: the analysis step's output above says how it ended."[0m
[36;1m  # AN AGENT FIX IS NOT FAILED BY ITS CHECK (#2240): its pull request is already open, so[0m
[36;1m  # a failed run would read as a failed fix — the chain's hard stop. Nothing published is[0m

[36;1m    echo "::warning::the fix is proposed, but its analysis could not be published, so the Control Center cannot tell whether it closed ${PC_TARGET}"[0m
[36;1m  echo "::error::the analysis of ${PC_ANALYSED_BRANCH} was not published to ${DATA_BRANCH}"[0m
[36;1m# THE VERDICT AND WHY, where a reader of this run looks. A `degraded` run analysed part[0m
[36;1m# of the project, and saying so beside the result is what keeps it from reading as a[0m
[36;1m# full one; the reasons were extracted once, by the analyse step.[0m

[36;1m    echo "#### Why this run covered less than the project"[0m
[36;1m    echo "**Nothing here says your code is wrong.**"[0m
[36;1m  # Only a republish that compiled sets this to `compile`.[0m
[36;1m    # SAID, because the verdict above is the earlier analysis's and nothing was analysed.[0m

[36;1m    echo "**Nothing was analysed.** Only module summaries changed since this branch's last analysis, so the specs were recompiled over it and its verdict carried; the merged summaries now show."[0m
[36;1m    # A fix DID change a branch — its own, above — so the sync's sentence would be false here.[0m
[36;1m    echo "Published to \`${DATA_BRANCH}\` under \`${PC_ANALYSED_BRANCH}/\`, so the Control Center can tell whether this fix closed \`${PC_TARGET}\`."[0m
[36;1m    echo "Published to \`${DATA_BRANCH}\` under \`${PC_ANALYSED_BRANCH}/\`. No branch of your code was changed."[0m
